scope: All five planned review sections: prior trust review retained; remaining four sections reviewed and targeted mutations executed. Not exhaustive generated mutation coverage.
method: Targeted source replacements in isolated copies, independent syntax check, baseline and restored baseline, full-suite follow-up for survivors.

functionReview.src/session-bridge.mjs: Prior trust-review.json covers provider selection, discover, resolve, create, archive, rename, send and ask. Source unchanged in this pass; full regression rerun.
functionReview.src/bridge/envelope.mjs: Prior trust review covers validation, escaping, request metadata and untrusted instructions. Source unchanged; full regression rerun.
functionReview.src/managed-session-instructions.mjs: Prior trust review covers provider instruction injection and relay/approval limits. Source unchanged; full regression rerun.
functionReview.src/bridge/deadline.mjs: Prior waiting review covers strict deadline, overflow, signal and timer cleanup. Used for usage timeout too; full regression rerun.
functionReview.src/providers/codex.mjs: parseDaemonVersion/parseCodexUsage, publicStatus, answerIn, pages/findInPages, mapSettled, isRootSession/toSession, list/cache/event snapshots, create/archive/rename/send/ask, daemonInfo/withClient/assertDaemonAvailable: cursor matching, incomplete discovery, loaded state, approval flags, RPC lifecycle and usage bound covered. Generated schema is evidence for pagination/status shape, not native model completion proof.
functionReview.src/providers/claude.mjs: Canonical project/worktree path, PID/registry join, parsers/status mapping, list/cache, create/archive/rename/send/ask/waitUntilIdle reviewed against existing tests. Native final-answer correlation limitation is explicit, not claimed solved.
functionReview.src/providers/claude-peer.mjs: processStart/version commands bounded; frame escaping/parsing, directory/target guards, start/send/waitForReply/waitForDisposition/stop/listen/disposition/accept/owned-file cleanup reviewed. Actual isolated Unix socket chunking, restart, held status, identity collision and stopping connected clients exercised.
functionReview.src/codex-app-server.mjs: connectUnixWebSocket/initialize/request/notify/close/send/onMessage/handleServerRequest/failAll/deniedServerRequest: fake frame tests plus real disposable Unix WebSocket handshake, timeout and close; signal cleanup, one submission and no approval bypass.
functionReview.src/claude-usage.mjs: parseWindow/parseClaudeUsage/readClaudeUsage/curlUsage: independently valid windows, clamps, expiry and status boundaries, credential preservation; fake curl executable tests default subprocess argv/stdin and failure paths without HTTP.
functionReview.src/overview.mjs: Order/reconciliation/move/filter/tree, formatting/status/usage/frame helpers and runOverview closures reviewed. Deferred discovery and native-open/resize/close races, forced refresh coalescing, storage warning and >40-session visibility tested. Rendering tests are string/EventEmitter checks, not a visual terminal proof.
functionReview.src/dock-order.mjs: canonicalWorkspace/validate/default path/load/saveWorkspace/read/write: private atomic replacement, malformed-state refusal, sequential writer re-read and rename failure cleanup.
functionReview.src/session-alias-catalog.mjs: validate/default path/load/set/read/write: same failure preservation boundaries; no claim of cross-process locking.
functionReview.src/tmux-workspace.mjs: Source fingerprint, result normalization, shell quoting, name/window parsing, enter/focusOrOpen/focusAgentsViewFromWindow/closeSessionView/reconcileSessionViews/shouldRefreshOverview/leave and metadata/frame/config/call helpers reviewed with mocks; real isolated tmux exercises normal reuse/dead revive/close/leave. Bounded control process and new session-view setup rollback tested.
functionReview.src/direct-workspace.mjs: defaultLaunch/focusOrOpen/leave/reconcile/close/refresh contract: argv, terminal hand-off/finally restore, failed launch and exit logging tested; temporary test state cleaned.
functionReview.src/native-launcher.mjs: nativeAgentsCommand/nativeSessionCommand/openNativeAgents/defaultLaunch: exact provider id, cwd and native daemon boundary retained. No real model frontend started.
functionReview.src/native-session-host.mjs: parseArgs/defaultLaunch/runNativeSessionHost/direct entry: actual disposable child process SIGTERM/SIGHUP forwarding, exit code 23, missing executable, invalid argv and diagnostic event order.
functionReview.src/session-dock.mjs: enterDirectDock/enterSessionDock: direct composition, optional tmux fallback only for unavailable executable; other failures must propagate.
functionReview.src/cli-options.mjs: parseCliArgs: defaults, aliases, backend/provider selection, separate positive safe timeout values, required operands and surplus open argument refusal.
functionReview.src/cli.mjs: Usage/default adapters/writeList/runCli/direct entry: dispatch, output separation, JSON preservation, runtime versus argument exit codes, and terminal-control neutralization in list fields.
functionReview.src/doctor.mjs: command/defaultDoctorProbes/runDoctor: bounded default probes inspected; injected probe failure/throw continues all required checks, optional tmux does not fail exit.
functionReview.src/event-log.mjs: default path/record: private append, no symlink following, immutable provenance, regular-file guard, descriptor finally cleanup and rotation recreation.
functionReview.src/product.mjs, src/demo.mjs, src/demo-: Constants/demo entrypoints excluded from mutation campaign; syntax and normal demo run are in npm run check.
functionReview.scripts/benchmark.mjs: Read warmup/sample/percentile/budget dispatch; benchmark excludes native providers and real terminal rendering.
functionReview.scripts/mutation-check.mjs: Checkout-isolated copies, exclusive new output directory, exact-one replacement, source syntax check, baseline gate, process group timeout/cleanup, survivor follow-up and report/hash persistence. Reports do not recursively hash prior review records.

findingsAndTestWeaknesses: RPC and peer socket lifecycle failures reproduced before fixes; stalled RPC and idle inbound peer connections detected by test deadlines.
Paginated turn/items lookup and repeated cursors, partial discovery safety, approval flags and unloaded target gating fixed.
Initial discovery exit, stale refresh, native-screen overwrite, forced refresh loss and signal listener leaks reproduced and fixed.
The first-forty display limit silently hid remaining sessions; a sixty-session regression verifies the default is unbounded.
Mutation removed HTTP status guard but tests still passed because all error responses had unusable bodies; valid-shaped bodies on 401/429/500 now kill it.
An overview assertion failure left a refresh interval running; shared afterEach cleanup converted process timeout to a meaningful failure.
A runtime JSON.parse SyntaxError was initially labeled a runner error. Source syntax is now checked independently; TAP testCodeFailure remains an ordinary detection.
tmux control timeout and newly created frontend rollback, CLI timeout overflow/extra args/control characters, log symlink/provenance addressed.
Final runner review corrected survivor full-suite argv slicing so no focused test filename remains; all four campaigns rerun against the corrected runner.
limitations: 52 targeted mutants are not the original 5061 generated candidates. Prior Stryker results retain their original hashes and are not pooled into this score.
Three mutants are detected by test deadlines, not ordinary assertions; raw TAP and separate classification are retained.
No live Claude/Codex agent session, native daemon, credential or user global configuration was modified. No native model or real OAuth HTTP response was requested.
Claude peer replies are source-socket matched; idle observation does not prove a correlated native turn or final transcript answer.
Store writes use atomic rename and re-read before writing but do not serialize simultaneous cross-process writers.
TTY rendering and real provider latency remain unverified; injected process/transport boundaries are stated explicitly.
Failures while setting up or rolling back a frontend can have unknown external outcomes; no destructive broad cleanup or automatic resend is introduced.
